tips.text: Run `vyre watchers` to see each watcher's state, project, schedule, items filed and next run.
`vyre watchers test harlow-invoices` dry-runs a watcher now and lists up to ten items. It files nothing.
Each watcher needs its own grant: `vyre vault grant billing-inbox watchers --watcher harlow-invoices`.
A watcher shows `changed` after its files are edited. Run `vyre watchers test`, check the items, then `vyre watchers create`.
Three failed runs in a row pause a watcher. Read `vyre watchers logs <name>`, fix the cause, then `vyre watchers resume <name>`.
`schedule` takes five-field cron in local time, like `*/15 * * * *`, or `@hourly` and `@daily`.
Ask Claude to watch a source: "watch the billing inbox for invoices and file them into Harlow Legal". It dry-runs before it turns on.
For a source that pushes, set `"schedule": "webhook"`. `vyre watchers create` then prints the route, header and token.
Run `vyre watchers items` to see what every watcher filed, or add a project slug for that project's items.
An agent's board in the Deck, `/agents/<name>`, lists its watchers, each with a switch to pause it and turn it back on.
